name: X Pulse
why: Built to skim X headlines at work. The feed was hand-picked sample posts, and live X data now needs a paid API plus a server, so this static site can't run it. Nitter-style mirrors are gone too.
learned: Category filters and a fast headline layout. Keep the UI; the data source has to be one you're allowed to use.

name: Video Downloader + Link Retriever
why: Browsers block cross-site downloads (CORS), so it failed on most sites, and pulling video off other sites runs into terms-of-service and copyright problems. Replaced by Video Toolbox, which edits your own files.
learned: Fetch streams, Blob URLs and progress bars. Those ideas live on in Video Toolbox's progress and save flow.
